name: navbar-menu

frames.best_why: Products dropdown is fully open with both product rows and their screenshots visible.

tagline: Hover a nav link and a bordered panel drops down with product previews.
summary: A compact rounded navigation with three word links. Hovering a link opens a panel beneath the bar, either with product rows showing screenshots or with a short column of sublinks.
appearance: A dark, fully rounded pill holding three plain word links. Hovering one opens a black rounded panel below it with a thin light border, listing either two product rows with small screenshots or a short stack of text links.
behaviour: Moving onto a link opens its panel, which scales and fades in with a spring and slides between links. Leaving the nav closes it, and links brighten slightly under the pointer.
demo_content: Design System and Analytics product rows with screenshots; Documentation, Changelog, Blog and Community links.
search_phrases: nav menu that opens on hover
top nav menu for a website
use_when: A compact top navigation where each link needs a rich panel of previews or several sublinks.
avoid_when: Touch and keyboard use: the panels are hover-only and never open on tap or focus.
customise: Compose Menu with MenuItem entries that take item, active and setActive, then put any panel content inside; colours and the spring are fixed in the source.
weight_why: A few nodes with one layout animation; nothing runs while closed.

a11y.note: Menu labels are plain paragraphs opened by mouse enter, so keyboard and touch users cannot open the panels.

issues: Panels open on hover only, so touch and keyboard users cannot reach them.
Frame 2 shows the product screenshots as grey loading placeholders.
The bar sits high with a large empty area beneath until a panel opens.
polish_why: Crisp dark pill and tidy panels; hover-only opening leaves touch and keyboard out.
title: Navbar Menu
